spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates precisely what changes for calling code when the WebIDL return type moves from undefined to Promise<undefined>, running the naive, normalised and shape-checked strategies against the live setter.

interactive.rationale: One button executes all three strategies for real; each strategy card shows its own live outcome and the page draws a build-level verdict from the combination.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index promises the naive TypeError happening live plus two surviving strategies; on a pre-158 build that is exactly what renders.

edge_cases.rationale: The whole page is the edge case (return-shape drift); it additionally handles unsupported browsers, rejection of the normalised await (the real 158 error channel), and a mixed/unexpected combination verdict.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5188639100370944 and the spec anchor.

conformance.rationale: The suite's returns-Promise assertions encode the same contract whose absence makes the naive strategy crash here; nothing in the suite was weakened to match the pre-158 result.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153 CDP driver: naive strategy threw the real TypeError (Cannot read properties of undefined, reading 'then') and was caught and displayed, normalise and inspect both survived, repeat run stable, zero console/page errors, zero failed requests, 0px overflow on both classes, screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the migration-safe paths complete and that the naive/inspect outcomes agree on one build shape; unsupported browsers assert the fallback branch.

design_system.rationale: Token colours only; ok results are emerald-dark on paper, failures rose on stone, both AA; code blocks scroll horizontally inside their cards.

accessibility.rationale: Native button, per-strategy results are aria-live=polite paragraphs, code samples are tabindex=0 for keyboard scroll, verdict is plain text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Strategy cards are single-column by construction; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800, verified by harness numbers and screenshots.

openQuestions.title: Confirm the naive strategy survives on a real Chrome 158 build
openQuestions.detail: On Chromium 153 the verified outcome is the drift TypeError plus two surviving strategies. On a 158+ build the page should render the all-three-survive verdict with the awaited undefined; confirm and capture that evidence when such a build is available.

guidanceConsulted.query: stacked card layout for sequential results without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer intrinsic single-column grids with gap over multi-column layouts for sequential, order-dependent content; let long monospace content scroll inside its own box.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Strategy cards are a single-column grid with design-token gaps; each pre scrolls internally (overflow-x:auto), measured 0px page overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give each independently-updating result its own polite region with stable position instead of one churning log.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each strategy's result paragraph is its own aria-live=polite region updated once per run, plus one closing verdict output.

summary: The return-shape-drift lesson run live: naive .then() chaining crashes with a caught TypeError on pre-158 builds while Promise.resolve() normalisation and the thenable check survive, mirroring the showcase's own anti-regression case. Verified with the headless Chromium 153 CDP driver: the crash, both safe paths and the repeat run all behaved as labelled; clean console/network, ok/ok responsive matrix.
